pr_title: Default zoom level for SpriteFrames editor plugin
pr_body:
sheet_zoom = MAX(1, EDSCALE); as instructed by @Calinou .

*Bugsquad edit: This closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/46836.*

issue_context.title: The SpriteFrames editor default zoom is too low on hiDPI displays
issue_context.body: **Godot version:** 3.2.3 **OS/device including version:** macOS 11.2.2, iMac 5K retina, Radeon Pro 570X 4GB, GLES3. **Issue description:** When I select the frames of a sprite sheet for an `AnimatedSprite` the image appears very small, as if it doesn't take into account the HDPI screen. I think a zoom could be implemented in this window. **Steps to reproduce:** - I create an AnimatedSprite. - I create a SpriteFrames. - I select "add frames from spritesheet". **Minimal reproduction project:** [animated-sprite-bug.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/6110291/animated-sprite-bug.zip)
comments:
The source code of the SpriteFrames editor plugin is here: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/editor/plugins/sprite_frames_editor_plugin.cpp

We can solve this by defaulting the zoom level to `MAX(1, EDSCALE)`, like we did in the 2D editor.
Would it literally be as simple as changing `sheet_zoom = 1.0f;` to `sheet_zoom = MAX(1, EDSCALE);` (line 1236)
Also a zoom like in Texture Region window of Sprites, would be nice.
I can work on this, can I be assigned?
@thorion21 Thanks for your interest in contributing! No need to be assigned – you can start working on it directly :slightly_smiling_face:
